tools.name: slide_create
tools.title: Create Slidev deck
tools.description: Generates a new talk-dir that references the Slidev theme given by `theme`. The theme is specified by a git URL with a tag (`git+https://<host>/<owner>/<repo>.git#<tag>`) or a local path (`file:<path>`). Returns the presentation categories (categories) and the list of selectable layouts (layouts). Also returns the lint result of the whole deck right after generation (generation counts as successful even with lint violations).

project_dir.description: Absolute path of the destination directory. Specify a place where the calling agent has write permission for later edits (e.g. under the working directory). Relative paths are not accepted. Windows-style paths (C:\... / \\wsl.localhost\<distro>\...) are accepted and converted to an absolute path under /mnt/<drive>/ or inside WSL.

theme.description: Theme to reference (required): `git+https://<host>/<owner>/<repo>.git#<tag>` or `file:<absolute path>`. A git URL without a tag is not accepted.

force.description: Delete and overwrite when the destination already exists

tools.name: slide_sync
tools.title: Sync Slidev deck
tools.description: Syncs an existing talk-dir. A pre-migration talk-dir (one that holds a copy of the template; slide_dev and others stop with theme-none) is moved to a form that references the theme given by `theme`. Files that came from the template are deleted, and the work area (slides.md / pages/*.md / public/slides/) is kept. The deleted names are returned in migration.removed. A migrated talk-dir that references a theme (theme: in slides.md points to the theme in dependencies of package.json) fetches the theme at the version in the dependency and relinks node_modules, and aligns the generated files (vite.config.ts, start.mjs) with the current content of the plugin. Other files are left unchanged. To raise the theme version, rewrite the #<tag> of the dependency in package.json before calling. Returns the presentation categories (categories), the list of selectable layouts (layouts), and the lint result of the whole deck after the sync. A running slide_dev must be stopped with stop: true and started again.

dir.description: Absolute path of the talk-dir to sync. Relative paths are not accepted. Windows-style paths (C:\... / \\wsl.localhost\<distro>\...) are accepted and converted to an absolute path under /mnt/<drive>/ or inside WSL.

theme.description: Theme the pre-migration talk-dir should reference: `git+https://<host>/<owner>/<repo>.git#<tag>` or `file:<absolute path>`. Required for a pre-migration talk-dir (one that holds a copy of the template). Not used for a migrated talk-dir

node_modules_only.description: Only relink node_modules. The theme in package.json is fetched first, then linked (no network access if it is already fetched). A migrated talk-dir that references a theme behaves the same even when this is omitted. The generated files (vite.config.ts, start.mjs) are also aligned with the current content of the plugin. Cannot be specified together with theme

tools.name: drawio_create
tools.title: Create draw.io diagram
tools.description: Turns drawio XML into a deliverable that opens directly in a browser. Writes viewer HTML (.html; opening it redirects to draw.io) to out_path and, by default, also writes a rendered PNG (useful for checking the rendering). icon:// references are resolved to data URIs and embedded. Before generating, it checks the diagram labels against the text rules and generates nothing if there is a violation. The font and font size are checked against the theme declaration (theme, or the theme of the talk-dir that is an ancestor of the diagram), and the result is returned in theme.

out_path.description: Absolute path of the .html file to write the viewer HTML to (opening it redirects to draw.io). If omitted, only the URL is returned in url. Windows-style paths (C:\... / \\wsl.localhost\<distro>\...) are accepted and converted to an absolute path under /mnt/<drive>/ or inside WSL.

theme.description: Theme used to check the font and font size: `git+https://<host>/<owner>/<repo>.git#<tag>`, `file:<absolute path>`, or the absolute path of a talk-dir or a theme root. If omitted, the theme of the talk-dir is used when the diagram is under its `public/`; otherwise the built-in default (sans-serif) is used. When the diagram for a slide is placed outside the talk-dir, pass the absolute path of the talk-dir. Windows-style paths (C:\... / \\wsl.localhost\<distro>\...) are accepted and converted to an absolute path under /mnt/<drive>/ or inside WSL.

tools.name: runtime_setup
tools.title: Set up runtime
tools.description: Downloads the runtime dependencies pecotv uses (@slidev/cli / dom-to-pptx / @slidev/parser, etc.) and Playwright Chromium. Call it when slide_create / slide_convert / slide_sync fail with "runtime dependencies are not installed", or when drawio_export / slide_convert / drawio_create PNG output fails with "Playwright Chromium is not installed". The first run downloads about 600MB of runtime dependencies and about 120MB of Chromium, so it takes tens of seconds. If OS libraries needed to launch Chromium are missing, it installs them with apt-get where sudo is available, and otherwise returns the command to install them. It skips what is already installed, so it finishes quickly and is safe to call repeatedly.

warnings.description: Warnings raised during the run (omitted when there are none). Beyond 100 warnings or 64KB, the last item tells how many were omitted

tools.name: file_lint
tools.title: Lint edited file
tools.description: Lints a file that was just written or edited. Slide pages and slides.md in a talk-dir are linted with the theme rules (eslint); other files are checked with the writing rules (pecot-text-lint) from the root of their git repository. Called by the PostToolUse hook after Write and Edit. Returns {} when there is nothing to report, otherwise hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext. Never fails.

file_path.description: Absolute path of the file that was written or edited (the hook passes tool_input.file_path)

cwd.description: Working directory of the session. Text rules for a file outside a git repository read .textlintignore from here

hookSpecificOutput.description: Present only when there is something to tell the agent

tools.name: file_validate
tools.title: Validate reference yaml
tools.description: Validates the reference yaml directory of a talk-dir when a yaml in it was edited, against the reference schema. Only directories listed in the theme lint.referencesDirectories are validated; _template.yaml is skipped. Called by the PostToolUse hook after Write and Edit. Returns {} when there is nothing to report, otherwise hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext. Never fails.

file_path.description: Absolute path of the file that was written or edited (the hook passes tool_input.file_path)

cwd.description: Working directory of the session. Text rules for a file outside a git repository read .textlintignore from here

hookSpecificOutput.description: Present only when there is something to tell the agent

tools.name: file_brief
tools.title: Brief layout conventions
tools.description: Returns the status, best_practices and anti_patterns sections, verbatim, of the reference yaml for the layout of an edited page under pages/ in a talk-dir, with the yaml path. It does not judge the page. Called by the PostToolUse hook after Write and Edit. Returns {} when there is nothing to report, otherwise hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext. Never fails.

file_path.description: Absolute path of the file that was written or edited (the hook passes tool_input.file_path)

cwd.description: Working directory of the session. Text rules for a file outside a git repository read .textlintignore from here

hookSpecificOutput.description: Present only when there is something to tell the agent
